definitions.goodRaw: Both blind reviewers judge the raw edit useful YES, objective satisfied YES, unauthorized meaning change NO, unsupported information NO, and voice preserved YES.
definitions.badRaw: Both blind reviewers identify a material unauthorized meaning change or unsupported information in the raw candidate. A style disagreement alone is insufficient.
definitions.caught: A jointly identified material raw defect is absent from final output. Count repair and source fallback separately.
definitions.escaped: A jointly identified material raw defect remains in final output.
definitions.goodLost: A jointly good raw edit is materially less useful in final output, including through fallback or harmful repair.
definitions.disputed: Any material reviewer disagreement is reported separately and excluded from agreed hard counts; no silent relabeling.
definitions.usefulRepair: Blind reviewers judge the repaired final text materially useful for the objective, source-grounded, and free of the raw defect. Byte difference from source is insufficient.
definitions.vagueGuess: An objective omits a replacement fact, yet the raw candidate, repair, or final output supplies an unsupported replacement value or new factual state.
